target.adapter: Fernway Supply banner and preferences dialog

surfaces: Network requests made by any page or worker in the browser context (attempted, whether or not they completed)
Events received by the collector, when one is configured (received)
Cookies in the browser context, for every domain, at the end of each step
localStorage keys of the page origin at the end of each step, matched against the policy

results.title: Fresh visit
results.question: Before the visitor chooses anything, does any optional tracker run?

results.title: Reject
results.question: After "reject", does anything optional start on this page, the next one, or a reload?

violations.expected: No analytics requests from the start of "navigate in the app", through the 1000 ms observation window.
The collector receives no analytics events from the start of "navigate in the app".
No analytics cookies at the end of "navigate in the app".
No analytics localStorage keys at the end of "navigate in the app".

firstViolation.expected: No analytics requests from the start of "navigate in the app", through the 1000 ms observation window.

results.title: Accept
results.question: Does analytics start only after it is accepted, and keep working across a client-side navigation?

results.title: Revoke
results.question: After analytics is revoked, do its requests stop and its cookies and storage go?

results.title: Revoke, then navigate
results.question: After revoking analytics, does a client-side navigation bring the tracker back?
